name: honor-product-receipts
description: Verify the four configured Honor Developer Products, live Marketplace identity/prices, durable receipt core, bounded world offers, dedicated Shop tab, and safe purchase controls without opening a checkout prompt.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='Honor Products Flow Phone 740x360' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=740,Height=360,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
assert(a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists')==true,'Shop host did not open') assert(a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Honor')==true,'Honor Shop did not open')
local s=g.GameMenu:FindFirstChild('FunctionalHeroShop') local tabs=s and s:FindFirstChild('ShopTabs') local expected={{'HonorPouch25',25,1,3708804891},{'HonorCache90',90,2,3708804911},{'HonorVault300',300,3,3708804933},{'HonorTreasury850',850,4,3708804944}}
local function inside(child,parent) if not child or not parent then return false end local cp,cs,pp,ps=child.AbsolutePosition,child.AbsoluteSize,parent.AbsolutePosition,parent.AbsoluteSize return cs.X>0 and cs.Y>0 and cp.X>=pp.X-1 and cp.Y>=pp.Y-1 and cp.X+cs.X<=pp.X+ps.X+1 and cp.Y+cs.Y<=pp.Y+ps.Y+1 end
local function shown(label,card,scroll) if not label or not inside(label,card) or scroll and not inside(card,scroll) then return false end local parent=label while parent and parent~=g do if parent:IsA('GuiObject') and not parent.Visible then return false end parent=parent.Parent end return label.TextTransparency<1 and label.TextBounds.X>0 and label.TextBounds.Y>0 end
local function fontFloor(label) if not label then return 0 end local limit=label:FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint') local size=label.TextScaled and limit and limit.MinTextSize or label.TextSize local parent=label while parent and parent~=g.Parent do local scale=parent:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIScale') if scale then size*=scale.Scale end parent=parent.Parent end return size end
-- Pure presentation predicate, also exercised offline with incorrect amount/price/identity controls.
local function evaluateHonor(f,e)
 return {identity=f.cardProductId==e[4] and f.actionProductId==e[4] and f.productKey==e[1],sale=f.lookup==true and f.forSale==true,configured=f.configured==true and f.unavailable==false,regional=f.resolved==true and f.livePrice>0 and f.cardPrice==f.livePrice and f.actionPrice==f.livePrice,amount=f.amountVisible==true and f.amountFits==true and tonumber(string.match(string.upper(f.amountText or ''),'(%d+)%s+HONOR'))==e[2],renderedPrice=f.priceVisible==true and f.priceFits==true and tonumber(f.priceText)==f.livePrice,detail=f.detailVisible==true and string.find(string.lower(f.detailText or ''),'relic gates',1,true)~=nil,action=f.actionVisible==true and f.active==true and f.selectable==true and f.bound==true and f.actionText=='BUY' and f.actionFits==true,touch=f.width>=48 and f.height>=48,readable=f.amountFont>=14 and f.priceFont>=14 and f.actionFont>=14,pips=f.pips==e[3]}
end
local deadline=os.clock()+8 local resolved=false repeat task.wait(.1) resolved=true for _,e in ipairs(expected) do local card=s and s:FindFirstChild(e[1]..'ShopCard',true) resolved=resolved and card and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true end until resolved or os.clock()>=deadline
local rows={} local ok=resolved and s~=nil and s.Visible==true and tabs~=nil and tabs:FindFirstChild('HonorShopTab')~=nil and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogItemCount')==4
for _,e in ipairs(expected) do
 local card=s and s:FindFirstChild(e[1]..'ShopCard',true) local scroll=s and s:FindFirstChild('ShopCatalogScroll') if card and scroll then local y=scroll.CanvasPosition.Y+card.AbsolutePosition.Y-scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.clamp(y,0,math.max(0,scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y))) task.wait(.1) end
 local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(e[1]..'Action',true) local price=card and card:FindFirstChild('Price',true) local detail=card and card:FindFirstChild('Detail',true) local amountLabel
 for _,name in ipairs({'Name','Rarity','Detail'}) do local label=card and card:FindFirstChild(name,true) if label and shown(label,card,scroll) and tonumber(string.match(string.upper(label.Text),'(%d+)%s+HONOR'))==e[2] then amountLabel=label break end end
 local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(e[4],Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local live=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0
 local fields={cardProductId=card and card:GetAttribute('ProductId'),actionProductId=action and action:GetAttribute('ProductId'),productKey=action and action:GetAttribute('ProductKey'),lookup=lookup,forSale=lookup and info.IsForSale==true,configured=card and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured'),unavailable=card and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable'),resolved=card and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved'),cardPrice=card and card:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice'),actionPrice=action and action:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice'),livePrice=live,amountVisible=shown(amountLabel,card,scroll),amountText=amountLabel and amountLabel.Text or '',amountFits=amountLabel and amountLabel.TextFits,priceVisible=shown(price,card,scroll),priceFits=price and price.TextFits,priceText=price and price.Text or '',detailVisible=shown(detail,card,scroll),detailText=detail and detail.Text or '',actionVisible=shown(action,card,scroll),active=action and action.Active,selectable=action and action.Selectable,bound=action and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound'),actionText=action and action.Text or '',actionFits=action and action.TextFits,width=action and action.AbsoluteSize.X or 0,height=action and action.AbsoluteSize.Y or 0,amountFont=fontFloor(amountLabel),priceFont=fontFloor(price),actionFont=fontFloor(action),pips=card and card:GetAttribute('HonorPackPipCount')}
 local checks=evaluateHonor(fields,e) local failed={} for name,value in pairs(checks) do if value~=true then table.insert(failed,name) end end local exact=#failed==0 ok=ok and exact rows[#rows+1]={id=e[1],exact=exact,checks=checks,failed=failed,fields=fields}
end
local result={ok=ok==true,rows=rows,items=s and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogItemCount'),safeViewport=tostring(g.AbsoluteSize)} assert(result.ok,'Honor Shop live configured state failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)
